summary: Silvaco Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Convertible Note Purchase Agreement with Micron Technology, Inc., a customer. The Company issued a $10.0 million senior convertible promissory note, unsecured, bearing 8.0% simple interest accruing without cash payments. The note automatically converts into common stock on August 7, 2028, or before a Change of Control, at the lower of 90% of fair market value or 115% of the closing price on the trading day prior to the note date. Conversion shares are subject to the Nasdaq Cap under Listing Rule 5635(d), requiring stockholder approval if exceeded. This is a strategic financing arrangement with a customer, not a standard special-situation event; watch for potential conversion dilution and stockholder approval mechanics.
